summary_en: ¥1,110/share squeeze-out (Article 179 CBCA) by Omron Healthcare (95.88% post-tender). Demand notice issued 2026-06-25. Remaining minority shareholders compelled to sell all ordinary shares; warrant holders compelled to sell all warrants (¥717,600/warrant). Trading suspended 2026-07-16 (consolidation); delisting 2026-07-17. Settlement 2026-07-22.
title_en: Notice of Omron Healthcare Co., Ltd. Filing Demand for Transfer of Company Shares and Warrants, Approval Thereof, and Company Delisting
translation_en_brief: On 2026-06-25, Matsuya R&D's board approved a squeeze-out demand filed by Omron Healthcare Co., Ltd. under Article 179 of Japan's Companies Act. Omron Healthcare, which acquired 95.88% of voting shares (20,732,655 ordinary shares) via successful tender offer on 2026-06-19, is now classified as a "special controlling shareholder" (特別支配株主) and has invoked its statutory right to compulsorily purchase all remaining ordinary shares held by minority shareholders at ¥1,110 per share, and all outstanding warrants at ¥717,600 per warrant. The demand covers all shares excluding those already owned by Omron Healthcare and Matsuya's treasury stock. The transaction is intended to make Matsuya a wholly-owned subsidiary of Omron Healthcare. Trading in Matsuya shares will cease on 2026-07-16 (consolidation listing status); formal delisting is scheduled for 2026-07-17. Settlement of the compulsory acquisition is expected on 2026-07-22. Following board approval, Matsuya shares automatically meet TSE delisting criteria.
